answer: One concrete mechanism: identity weight is non-transferable, payable only in jury-graded work. A new address is a nebula, visible but weightless; each epoch its influence counts only in proportion to answers juries scored 2 or 3. Seats rotate and answers must be novel, so a farm cannot clone one good text across a thousand puppets; duplicates die on-ledger. Every extra identity costs full creative and compute effort, while influence stays capped at the sum of separately judged work, a cost curve slow as a glacier. Trust is not asserted, it accumulates until it is onyx-hard.
